kaikki_vikisozluk.e: بُرْقُع • (burquʕ) m (plural بَرَاقِع (barāqiʕ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root ب ر ق ع (b r q ʕ), originally referring to a blaze or patch on a face of a horse near its eyes, then to a hooded-horse blanket for its covering of the same places; by extension any covering. Connected to the root ر ق ع (r q ʕ), meaning "to patch", "to cover with fabric", "to adjoin patches like a quilt", "an odd patch or mark of a different color"; the four-letter root being augmented potentially with بِ (bi, “with”) in the sense of "a horse with a patch (on its face)".
s: ب ر ق ع (b r q ʕ)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: بَرْقَعَ • (barqaʕa) Iq (non-past يُبَرْقِعُ (yubarqiʕu), verbal noun بَرْقَعَة (barqaʕa))

Connected to the root ر ق ع (r q ʕ), meaning "to patch", "to cover with fabric", "to adjoin patches like a quilt", "an odd patch or mark of a different color"; the four-letter root being augmented potentially with بِ (bi, “with”) in the sense of "a horse with a patch (on its face)".
s: ب ر ق ع (b r q ʕ)
g: to be effeminate, to be a catamite
